title: a finger's drag pans a touch widget, arriving as touch

interactions.name: the page's listeners work over the mirror
the finger's pan reaches the page
the gesture arrives as the touch it was
the landside browser claims the touchscreen the reader has

interaction.reason: the landside browser is a phone with a mouse: touch is never emulated and no drag path exists for a non-canvas widget (P-111), so the pan never arrives — and if it did, it would arrive wearing a mouse

notes: three checks, three layers: the pan arriving at all is P-111's drag path; arriving as pointerType touch and the page seeing maxTouchPoints > 0 are P-006's touch emulation, which only makes sense arriving together with touch input to feed it
